# Editable

Editable separates editable draft state from accepted application value.

## Capabilities

- Inline edit mode.
- Draft value separation.
- Commit or cancel.
- Normalization and validation policy.
- Focus handoff.
- Controlled value.

## Package availability

| Package | Import | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core | `@sectile/core/editable` | Published |
| DOM | `@sectile/dom/editable` | Published |
| Terminal | `@sectile/terminal/editable` | Published |
| Vue | `@sectile/vue/editable` | Workspace preview |

## Usage

Import the public component subpath for the host you are building. Namespace imports keep the available state, events, controllers, and projection helpers together while the API is explored.

::: code-group

```ts [Core]
import * as editable from '@sectile/core/editable'
```

```ts [DOM]
import * as editable from '@sectile/dom/editable'
```

```ts [Terminal]
import * as editable from '@sectile/terminal/editable'
```

```ts [Vue]
import * as editable from '@sectile/vue/editable'
```

:::

## Supported scenarios

- Basic.
- Validated.
- Controlled.

DOM and terminal scenarios refine the same semantic state. Host packages may expose different input and rendering helpers while preserving accepted transitions and controlled ownership.

## Interaction states

Component state that changes user-owned data supports controlled or uncontrolled ownership where listed above. Host projections distinguish disabled interaction from readonly inspection when the underlying control permits both.

## Semantics

The component contract follows [Sectile theory](/references/sectile-theory#10-text-theory). Visual styling remains outside the package; use host attributes, parts, and state projections as styling hooks.
